scope: Public authoring example. The reference report was approved after privacy edits. A sample run is separate evidence and is not a new approval of its writing.
method: Three steps: check inputs, write, render and save.
source_changes: Pass the complete approved text directly to the writer, without hidden markers.
Use normal Codex file tools; retain only source-panel inspection and optional calculations.
Render and save once, with explicit supporting files.
Render normal Markdown links and images, or name the missing file.
Build browsing pages only for available records.

historical_checks.regression_tests: 6 passed; ordinary Markdown, selected passages, unknown citations, range bounds, optional/incomplete calculations, saved file integrity.
historical_checks.reference_build: Complete redacted reference: draft check, build, and save passed without calculation files.

full_sample_run.earlier_failure: Writer cited its generated calculation file. Added source views for existing calculation files; unchanged writer output then passed draft check, build, save, and browser checks.

current_checks.mechanical_sample: Passed: Markdown and source links, passage bounds, explicit supporting files, source preservation, save retry integrity, and optional calculations.

live_sample_run.result: The report distinguishes planning from completed work and states the sample scope. Calculations were optional and supplied explicitly.
live_sample_run.browser: 36 source controls; opened a source at 1440px and 390px; no page errors or horizontal overflow.

current_checks.writing_approval: The reference is approved; a new generated report still requires review.
